patch_description:
The validation failure trace shows the evaluator could not properly load the module (`spec.loader` was `None`), which commonly happens when the submitted file is malformed or not importable as a normal Python module. I kept the program import-safe and ensured the EVOLVE block contains a clean, valid `generate_signal` implementation with the same input/output contract.

I also improved the trading logic to be more robust: dynamic entry thresholds based on ATR/ADX, RSI trend filters, volatility-adjusted stop loss / take profit, asymmetric long/short rules, and simple signal smoothing using recent bar context when available. No external libraries beyond `numpy` and `random` are used, and the code remains self-contained.
